summary: Detect discrete high-amplitude co-fluctuation events in zebrafish whole-brain calcium data by computing the RMS of pairwise edge co-fluctuations at every frame, building a circular-shift null distribution, and thresholding with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR-corrected empirical p-values.
use_when: Run the Circular-null co-fluctuation event detection recipe

Detect discrete high-amplitude co-fluctuation events in zebrafish whole-brain calcium data by computing the RMS of pairwise edge co-fluctuations at every frame, building a circular-shift null distribution, and thresholding with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR-corrected empirical p-values.
avoid_when: The intended conclusion requires causal inference from an observational association alone
